limits: Same checkpoint/engines, node-local warmed file paths for every mode, current public mono loader, B1 frontend graphs;11alternating repeats. Each sample includes executor creation/join, headers, read/decode/resample and full streaming request. CPU preloading only prepares reference outputs. No cold disk/Lustre/network claim. All session pools resident, not standalone VRAM; future loaded batches bounded by count not bytes. No combined frontend/mono gain claim.
